subject: Media Literacy
title: Algorithmic Amplification of Propaganda
description: A quick, practical guide to Algorithmic Amplification of Propaganda.

hook.text: YouTube's algorithm recommended conspiracy videos 70% of the time after watching factual news content.

buildup.text: Social media algorithms prioritize engagement. Outrage and conspiracy generate massive engagement.

discovery.text: This means algorithms naturally amplify propaganda — not by design, but by optimizing for clicks.

twist.text: Tech companies profit from engagement. Propaganda is engaging. The business model rewards disinformation.

climax.text: The algorithm is the most powerful propaganda tool ever created — and it has no ideology.

punchline.text: The algorithm doesn't pick sides. It picks outrage.

quiz.question: Why do social media algorithms naturally amplify propaganda?
options: Propaganda generates high engagement, which algorithms reward
